content: C-0001-REVISED (replaces disputed C-0001): Hypnosis produces DIRECTION-CONSISTENT but HETEROGENEOUS changes in large-scale brain network connectivity. Posterior regions (precuneus, cuneus, lingual gyrus) are the most reliably implicated across independent groups (de Matos 2023, Vazquez 2023, Landry ALE 2017). The DLPFC-centric 'three-signature' pattern (dACC↓, DLPFC-insula↑, DLPFC-PCC↓) originates primarily from the Stanford/Spiegel group and is NOT cleanly replicated by independent groups — Vazquez found no ECN/DMN differences. There is NO single, unique, individually-classifiable neural signature (this is now consistent with C-0002). supports: EV-0001, EV-0002, EV-0006, EV-0007, EV-0028, EV-0029. contradicts: none (resolved tension with C-0002).
